name: core
description: Engine-neutral delivery of a Distribution edition onto a Dynamicweb 10 host reached by URL and Admin API key. Every pipeline item runs this.

proof.statement: Delivered onto blank Dynamicweb 10.30.8 hosts, end to end: base-only (the PIM-only composition) twice, base-only with the example PIM solution on top, and swift-demo (the storefront with sample data). After each, the row counts the edition declares were read back from the database as declared. Run on Windows with PowerShell 7 against IIS hosts restarted by command; a restart through the Dynamicweb Cloud control file and a delivery from a Linux agent are unmeasured.
